# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi
# SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later
"""Commit closed phase-cache qualification, preserving original outcomes."""
from pathlib import Path
import difflib
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import re

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
W = G / '.worktree/feat-phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013'
C = G / '.worktree/diag-native-copy-queue-qualified-20261013'
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-phase-cache-runtime-admission'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase_admission_publication_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def hashes(value, key=''):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: hashes(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [hashes(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and key != 'sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
        return dict(sha256=value)
    return value


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(hashes(value), indent=2) + '\n')


def archive(path, target):
    dump(target, dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), text=path.read_text()))


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-phase-cache-admission-publication-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not F.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True, commands=[],
             evidence={}, gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False)

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    env = dict(load(B / 'main-phase-cache-full-build-root-v5/record.json')['environment'])

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):
        print('OWNED PUBLICATION ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=300, cpu=1800, rss_cap=2 << 30,
                            text_cap=4 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '410904c99d273435b5302fa8976cc667d17957f2'
        assert run('branch', ['git', 'branch', '--show-current']) == 'feat/phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013'
        assert not run('local-identity', ['git', 'config', '--local', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'], (1,))
        run('author-identity', ['git', 'var', 'GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        receipt_names = [
            'main-phase-cache-host-check-root-v1', 'main-phase-cache-host-check-root-v2',
            'main-phase-cache-server-check-root-v2', 'main-phase-cache-full-build-root-v2',
            'main-phase-cache-full-build-root-v3', 'main-phase-cache-full-build-root-v4',
            'main-phase-cache-full-build-root-v5', 'main-phase-cache-full-lints-root-v1',
            'main-phase-cache-full-lints-root-v2', 'main-phase-cache-full-lints-root-v3',
            'main-phase-cache-vmm-tiny-root-v2']
        originals = {name: B / name / 'record.json' for name in receipt_names}
        receipts = {name: load(path) for name, path in originals.items()}
        for name, data in receipts.items():
            assert not data['active'], name
            assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for c in data['commands']), name
        build = receipts['main-phase-cache-full-build-root-v5']
        lint = receipts['main-phase-cache-full-lints-root-v3']
        tiny = receipts['main-phase-cache-vmm-tiny-root-v2']
        assert build['passed'] and build['complete'] and lint['passed'] and lint['complete']
        assert lint['lints_qualified'] and not lint['novel_findings']
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in build['source_pins'].items())
        assert build['source_pins'] == lint['source_pins'] == tiny['source_pins']
        assert m.sha(build['worktree'] + '/build/free/strata') == build['free']['binary_sha256']
        assert m.sha(build['worktree'] + '/build/contrib-llvm/strata') == build['contrib-llvm']['binary_sha256']
        F.mkdir()
        derivations = []
        for name, data in receipts.items():
            public = {key: value for key, value in data.items() if key != 'evidence'}
            public['output_evidence'] = {}
            for label, outputs in data.get('evidence', {}).items():
                public['output_evidence'][label] = {}
                for stream, text in outputs.items():
                    import hashlib
                    rows = text.splitlines()
                    keep = rows if name in ('main-phase-cache-full-build-root-v5',
                                           'main-phase-cache-full-build-root-v4') else [
                        row for row in rows if re.search(r'PASS|FAIL|SKIP|Error|error:|warning:|Ran |OK$|FAILED|strata phase-cache:|BEGIN tiny|PHASE map|== ', row)]
                    public['output_evidence'][label][stream] = dict(bytes=len(text.encode()),
                        sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(), retained_lines=keep,
                        extraction='All v4/v5 output; other receipts retain diagnostic/progress/check summaries. Original pinned receipt stays unchanged.')
            target = F / 'receipts' / (name + '.json')
            dump(target, public)
            derivations.append(dict(original_path=str(originals[name]), original_sha256=m.sha(originals[name]),
                                    public_path=str(target.relative_to(F)), public_sha256=m.sha(target)))
        dump(F / 'receipt-derivations.json', derivations)
        for name in ('main-phase-cache-full-build-preflight-v1-failed.json', 'main-phase-cache-vmm-tiny-preflight-v1-failed.json'):
            archive(B / name, F / 'preflight-failures' / name)
        proof = {}
        for mode in ('free', 'contrib-llvm'):
            db = load(W / 'build' / mode / 'compile_commands.json')
            entry = next(row for row in db if row['file'] == str(W / 'src/program/generate.cpp'))
            assert all(flag in entry['command'] for flag in ('-fsycl', '-Werror', '-Wall', '-Wextra'))
            proof[mode] = dict(compile_entry=entry, compile_database_sha256=m.sha(W / 'build' / mode / 'compile_commands.json'),
                               binary_sha256=build[mode]['binary_sha256'], vmm_binary_sha256=build[mode]['vmm_fixture_sha256'])
        dump(F / 'build-proof.json', proof)
        for name in ('main-phase-cache-full-build-v2.py', 'main-phase-cache-full-build-v5.py',
                     'main-phase-cache-full-lints-v3.py', 'main-phase-cache-vmm-tiny-v2.py',
                     'main-phase-cache-admission-publication-v1.py'):
            archive(B / name, F / 'controllers' / (name + '.json'))
        names = [
            'research-full262144-nonmtp-prefill-admission-round364-v1.txt',
            'research-scratch-alias-production-comparison-route-round365-v1.txt',
            'research-head-tensor-owner-lease-round366-v1.txt',
            'research-phase-all-expert-cache-lease-round367-v1.txt',
            'research-prefill-12288-shape-admission-round368-v1.txt',
            'research-decode-packed-working-set-temporal-reuse-round369-v1.txt',
            'research-decode-packed-working-set-temporal-reuse-round369-v2.txt',
            'research-decode-route-reuse-instrumentation-round370-v1.txt',
            'research-decode-route-reuse-instrumentation-round370-v2.txt',
            'research-decode-avx2-quantized-roofline-round371-v1.txt',
            'research-decode-avx2-quantized-roofline-round371-v2.txt',
            'implementation-full-main-context-probe-v1.txt',
            'implementation-phase-native-head-lease-v1.txt',
            'implementation-phase-native-head-lease-parent-lint-fixes-v1.txt']
        report_pins = []
        for name in names:
            target = F / 'research' / (name + '.json')
            archive(B / 'research-20261009' / name, target)
            report_pins.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)), sha256=m.sha(target)))
        previous = G / '.worktree/feat-fixed-history-logits-comparator-20261013/bench/results/2026-10-13-upstream-benchsh-quiet-copy-pair/report-registry-v185.json'
        count = load(previous)['research_completed'] + len(report_pins)
        dump(F / 'report-registry-v186.json', dict(research_completed=count, prior=dict(path=str(previous),
            git_revision='010909772b621c71f1c635b4e1ccc37b36afbe4f', sha256=m.sha(previous)),
            new_reports=report_pins, main_only_test_execution=True))
        for label, tree, base in (
                ('head-lease', G / '.worktree/feat-phase-native-head-lease-20261013', W),
                ('full-main-context', G / '.worktree/feat-full-main-context-probe-20261013', C)):
            assert run(label + '-head', ['git', '-C', str(tree), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '410904c99d273435b5302fa8976cc667d17957f2'
            changed = run(label + '-changed', ['git', '-C', str(tree), 'diff', '--name-only']).splitlines()
            changed += run(label + '-new', ['git', '-C', str(tree), 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).splitlines()
            updates = []
            for name in sorted(set(changed)):
                path, original = tree / name, base / name
                after = path.read_text()
                before = original.read_text() if original.is_file() else ''
                if before == after:
                    continue
                patch = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(keepends=True), after.splitlines(keepends=True),
                                                    fromfile='a/' + name, tofile='b/' + name))
                updates.append(dict(path=name, base_path=str(original), base_sha256=m.sha(original) if original.is_file() else None,
                                    source_sha256=m.sha(path), unified_diff=patch))
            dump(F / 'candidate-source-unqualified' / (label + '.json'), dict(worktree=str(tree),
                base_worktree=str(base), patches=updates, main_reviewed_source_only=True,
                built=False, tested=False, runtime_qualified=False, physical_fit_qualified=False,
                owner='Main', byte_budget=2 << 20, consumer='Main sourceLLVM builds, host correctness and runtime qualification',
                next_review='After candidate source is qualified and committed'))
        summary = dict(main_reviewed=True, source_parent='410904c99d273435b5302fa8976cc667d17957f2',
            source_pins=build['source_pins'], sourceLLVM_builds_passed=['free', 'contrib-llvm'],
            host_release_passed=True, host_asan_ubsan_passed=True, server_phase_tests_passed=2,
            preceding_full_server_suite_passed=249, new_lint_findings=0,
            existing_lint_findings_retained=True, raw_full_lint_exit=1,
            tiny_vmm_passed=bool(tiny['passed']), tiny_vmm_error=tiny.get('error'),
            actual_tiny_vmm_qualified=bool(tiny.get('actual_tiny_vmm_qualified', False)),
            real_provider_map_error_atomicity_proven=False, model_executed=False,
            model_qualified=False, full_physical262144_qualified=False, quality_qualified=False,
            adopted=False, performance_sample_added=False, reset_executed=False, service_changes=False,
            regression_comparison_method='Unchanged pristine upstream bench.sh --long --runs 3',
            research_registry_count=count,
            main_errata=[
                'R365 applies the superseded strict32768 minimum; current declared stock comparison accepts actual >=32000. Historical strict32768 fields remain false.',
                'R368 4095 tail is for ordinary 262143 prefill plus final token. Zero-output full262144 at chunk12288 ends with4096; no12K fit is proved.',
                'R369v1 confused one-expert/layer aggregate with top10; corrected v2 is authoritative.',
                'R370v1 omitted segmented Verifier stream_sync and mislabeled fixed-source hashes as dirty-target hashes; corrected v2 is authoritative.',
                'R371v1 confused Q4_0 block bytes/type with native Q2_0; corrected v2 is authoritative. NT>4 proposals need the actual route to expose that batch.'],
            next_step='Actual phase OFF/ON fresh GEN + normal QUIT admission, then unchanged upstream stock bench; separately qualify aliases/head lease/full256K probe and production logits/state diagnostics.')
        dump(F / 'summary.json', summary)
        ja = '''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Phase cache の実行前検査

既定 OFF の phase expert cache を実装しました。prefill の workspace を
退役してから追加 expert を map、fill、readback、residency 比較し、decode に
使います。次の fresh GEN では graph reader を退役して追加 mapping を外します。
KV、GDN、PLE の所有 buffer と数値形式は交換しません。不明な map/unmap
状態は fail-stop し、所有権を process 終了まで保持します。

Arc B570 / Ryzen 5600X の環境で、source-built DPC++ 7.1.1 による free と
contrib-llvm のビルド、CPU 所有権テスト、別ビルドの ASan/UBSan、サーバーの
phase 寿命 2 テストが通りました。直前の全サーバー 249 テストも記録しています。
全変更ファイルの lint は変更前の実コードと照合し、新規指摘は 0 件です。
既存の mypy、CMake、解析指摘があるため lint 単体の exit は 1 です。
初回失敗や型比較で止まった v4 ビルドの結果を成功へ書き換えていません。

小さな実 VMM 検査の結果は summary.json と receipts に保存しています。
この検査は model、verifier graph、速度、品質、全物理 262144 入力を認定しません。
実 provider の map/unmap エラー注入も行っていません。次は二つの fresh GEN と
正常 QUIT を確認してから、変更していない上流 bench.sh で性能を比較します。
生成文の完全一致を一般の品質合格条件にはしません。

並行調査は registry v186 に保存しました。誤りのあった元報告と修正版を
併記し、Main の訂正を summary.json に残しています。head lease と full-context
probe は source 差分だけを保存し、ビルド、実行、物理メモリ効果は unverified です。
閉じた処理の重複ログだけを、証拠と hash を照合した削除 manifest に従って退役します。
元の pinned receipt は変更せず保持します。
'''
        en = '''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Phase cache admission checks

The default-OFF phase expert cache retires prefill workspace before mapping,
filling, reading back and comparing extra expert residency for decode. The next
fresh GEN retires graph readers before removing those mappings. KV, GDN and PLE
owners and numerical formats remain the same. Uncertain map/unmap state stops
the process and retains ownership until exit.

On Arc B570 / Ryzen 5600X, source-built DPC++ 7.1.1 builds in free and
contrib-llvm passed, together with CPU ownership tests, a separate host
ASan/UBSan build and two server phase lifetime tests. The preceding full server
suite passed249 tests. All changed-source lints were compared with an actual
pristine baseline, with zero new findings. Existing mypy, CMake and analyzer
findings keep the raw lint exit at1. Earlier failures, including the v4 build's
signed comparison error, retain their original failed outcomes.

The tiny actual VMM result is in summary.json and receipts. It does not qualify
the model, verifier graphs, speed, quality or full physical262144 input. No real
provider map/unmap error injection was performed. Next, verify two fresh GENs
and normal QUIT before measuring with unchanged upstream bench.sh. Exact prose
identity is not a universal quality gate.

Parallel research is retained in registry v186, including original reports and
corrections. Main's errata are in summary.json. Head lease and full-context probe
are archived as source deltas only; their builds, runtime and physical memory
effects are unverified. Closed-run duplicate logs retire only after evidence
and hash verification, under the deletion manifest. Original pinned receipts
remain unchanged.
'''
        (F / 'REPORT.ja.md').write_text(ja)
        (F / 'REPORT.md').write_text(en)
        # Development docs describe behavior; qualification belongs in reports.
        for name, sentence in (
            ('docs/PHASE_DECODE_CACHE.ja.md', 'これらの source 変更の build、runtime、性能は未検証です。'),
            ('docs/PHASE_DECODE_CACHE.md', 'Build,\nruntime behavior and performance of these source changes remain unverified.')):
            path = W / name
            text = path.read_text()
            assert text.count(sentence) == 1
            path.write_text(text.replace(sentence, '').rstrip() + '\n')
        deletions = []
        for name, path in originals.items():
            data = receipts[name]
            for raw in sorted((path.parent / 'commands').glob('*')):
                if raw.suffix not in ('.stdout', '.stderr') or not raw.is_file():
                    continue
                label = raw.stem
                stream = raw.suffix[1:]
                assert raw.read_text() == data['evidence'][label][stream]
                deletions.append(dict(path=str(raw), bytes=raw.stat().st_size, sha256=m.sha(raw),
                    replacement='receipts/' + name + '.json',
                    reason='Closed command output represented in unchanged pinned original receipt and reviewed compact evidence'))
        retention = dict(deletions=deletions, deleted=False, owner='Main', active_runs_touched=False,
                         original_failed_status_retained=True, original_pinned_receipts_retained=True,
                         byte_budget=4 << 20, consumer='Phase-cache model admission and source-only candidate qualification',
                         next_review='After phase model qualification or superseding failure evidence', free_space_claim=False)
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', retention)
        files = [str(path.relative_to(W)) for path in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if path.is_file()]
        files += ['docs/PHASE_DECODE_CACHE.ja.md', 'docs/PHASE_DECODE_CACHE.md']
        assert 'skipped (' not in run('report-doc-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *files])
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'])
        for name, sha in build['source_pins'].items():
            if not name.startswith('docs/'):
                assert m.sha(W / name) == sha
        for row in derivations:
            assert m.sha(row['original_path']) == row['original_sha256']
        for row in deletions:
            assert m.sha(row['path']) == row['sha256']
        for row in deletions:
            Path(row['path']).unlink()
        retention.update(deleted=True, removed_file_count=len(deletions), removed_logical_bytes=sum(row['bytes'] for row in deletions))
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', retention)
        stage = [*build['source_pins'], str(F.relative_to(W))]
        run('stage', ['git', 'add', '--', *stage])
        run('commit', ['git', 'commit', '-m', 'feat(xe): add guarded phase cache with ownership admission checks'])
        r['commit'] = run('committed-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['git', 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'feat/phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013'])
        assert not run('final-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, research_registry_count=count,
                 removed_files=len(deletions), removed_logical_bytes=retention['removed_logical_bytes'])
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({key: r.get(key) for key in ('passed', 'error', 'commit', 'research_registry_count', 'removed_files')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
